scope: Feature SESSION-INTEGRATION, change OBSERVE-001: add a temporary opt-in diagnostic PTY launcher for the existing installed Codex integration to capture bounded input classifications and lifecycle metadata without prompts/typed characters. Do not change warming policy or claim the remaining real-terminal failure fixed.

acceptance.description: Explicit diagnostic command invokes the existing installed runtime/autoload and recorded native executable with original user arguments/environment/cwd, forwarding exact input/output bytes without autoanswering terminal queries or modifying trust/settings.

Opt-in diagnostic evidence stores bounded input categories, sizes, timestamps, redacted protocol families/event types and filtered lifecycle/policy metadata only. No prompt/output contents, typed characters, numeric character keycodes, credentials or raw unknown control bodies are retained.

Retain a bounded chronological event ring, safe source/runtime identity and owned cleanup receipt with usable artifact path. Distinguish enhanced press/repeat/release, passive/unknown/incomplete traffic and current owner state without changing scheduling.

Real PTY fixture verifies exact Buffer forwarding, fragmentation, argv/env/cwd, resize/exit, privacy sentinel exclusion and bounded metadata. No model calls or personal file/process changes; only launcher-owned child tree is cleaned up.
